body:
herdr's status protocol is OSC 7501 (state=blocked|working|done, app=…). Probed: a program printing that sequence leaves no trace — `zmx history` and `zmx history --vt` both consume it in the VT parser, and zmx's own ZMX_TASK_COMPLETED:<token>:$? marker stays because it is plain text.

So herdr-style 'who needs me' cannot be read back out of zmx. The lazy equivalent is a label: whatever runs in the session calls `zmx set <name> state=blocked`, and every reader gets it in the same `zmx ls` parse. Same cooperation requirement as OSC 7501, no protocol, no server, no parser.
title: OSC 7501 does not survive zmx; the label does
